title: Change without surprises
sub: Film 7 of 19 of a series on data governance: Sweden switched sides of the road in one morning, and surprised no one. A change to data can do the same, if everyone it reaches knows what changes, when, and what to do.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms and in Sweden in 1967. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions and what a change reaches; green is adding, and ready; red is breaking; violet is the glossary's meaning of award.
